inspirations.title: Grace in Weakness
inspirations.text: God's power is made perfect in weakness. Your struggles are not disqualifications — they're invitations for grace to show up in powerful ways.

inspirations.title: Be Still
inspirations.text: In a world that never stops moving, God says, 'Be still and know.' Take a moment. Breathe. Let God be God. Listen for Him and you will know His Presence.

inspirations.title: You Are Seen
inspirations.text: When the world feels too loud and you feel invisible, remember: the God who counts the stars also knows your name.

hero.headline: Seek God for Revival
hero.subheadline: Heartbeat Ministries exists to strengthen faith, share Scripture, and stand with you in prayer — so light stays visible, even in hard seasons.
hero.verse_text: You are the light of the world

about.mission: We exist to bring Scripture-centered encouragement, prayer support, and practical faith for real life — so people can see hope clearly, like a city on a hill.

trivia.q: How many days did God take to create the world?
trivia.explain: God created the world in six days and rested on the seventh.

trivia.q: Who built the ark?
trivia.explain: God instructed Noah to build an ark to survive the great flood.

trivia.q: What is the first book of the Bible?
trivia.explain: Genesis means 'beginning' — it's the first book of the Bible.

trivia.q: How many disciples did Jesus have?
trivia.explain: Jesus chose twelve apostles to follow Him and spread the Gospel.

trivia.q: Who was swallowed by a great fish?
trivia.explain: Jonah was swallowed by a great fish after fleeing from God's command.

trivia.q: What are the first four books of the New Testament called?
trivia.explain: The four Gospels tell the story of Jesus' life, death, and resurrection.

trivia.q: Who killed Goliath?
trivia.explain: Young David defeated the giant Goliath with a sling and a stone.

trivia.q: What did God create on the first day?
trivia.explain: God said 'Let there be light,' and there was light.

trivia.q: Who was the first man?
trivia.explain: God formed Adam from the dust of the ground and breathed life into him.

trivia.q: What is the longest book in the Bible?
trivia.explain: The Book of Psalms contains 150 chapters, making it the longest book.

trivia.q: Who parted the Red Sea?
trivia.explain: God parted the Red Sea through Moses to deliver Israel from Egypt.

trivia.q: What was the name of Jesus' mother?
trivia.explain: The angel Gabriel told Mary she would bear a son and name Him Jesus.

trivia.q: How many books are in the Bible?
trivia.explain: The Bible has 66 books — 39 in the Old Testament and 27 in the New Testament.

trivia.q: Who denied Jesus three times?
trivia.explain: Peter denied knowing Jesus three times before the rooster crowed, just as Jesus foretold.

trivia.q: Where was Jesus born?
trivia.explain: Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea, fulfilling Old Testament prophecy.

trivia.q: What is the shortest verse in the Bible?
trivia.explain: \"Jesus wept\" (John 11:35) is the shortest verse in the English Bible.

trivia.q: Who was thrown into a den of lions?
trivia.explain: Daniel was thrown into the lions' den for praying to God, but God shut the lions' mouths.

trivia.q: What are the Ten Commandments also called?
trivia.explain: The Ten Commandments are also known as the Decalogue, meaning 'ten words.'

trivia.q: Who wrote most of the Psalms?
trivia.explain: King David is credited with writing approximately 73 of the 150 Psalms.

trivia.q: What is the last book of the Bible?
trivia.explain: The Book of Revelation, written by John, is the final book of the Bible.

memoryVerses.text: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.
And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.
But those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint.
You are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hidden.
For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
